values.note: 13 sites in two loops (3 pull-through); all tent sites are in the lower loop. The FS describes adequate turnaround and parking for RVs but posts no length limit.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/highway-springs-campground ('13 campsites (3 are pull-through) with tables and fireplaces, 2 vault type toilets, and adequate turnaround and parking space for RV's'; 'The lower loop ... includes all the tent sites'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No drinking water or firewood provided.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/highway-springs-campground ('2 vault type toilets'; 'No drinking water or firewood is provided'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day (2026 concessionaire season began May 22).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/highway-springs-campground ('Open Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day'; 'Concessionaire operations for 2026 season begin May 22nd'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Pay by envelope at the collection box near the entrance (cash or check).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/highway-springs-campground (no reservation channel; 'There is a 14 day stay limit'; 'Fee envelopes and a collection box are provided near the entrance'; 'Please be prepared to pay with cash or check'), read 2026-10-28

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/highway-springs-campground ('Overnight Use: Single Site: $23 per night'), read 2026-10-28

note: Rio Grande NF campground at ~8,400 ft just off US 160, 4.1 mi southwest of South Fork toward Wolf Creek Pass. The upper loop circles a knoll above the highway under mature ponderosa; access down to the South Fork of the Rio Grande for fishing. --Claude
